# Owned HWT XMLTemplate read-only fixture

This synthetic CFB was generated by `build/xml-format95/source/tests/xml_template95.rs` using the existing cfb crate. It contains FileHeader, XMLTemplate/Schema, XMLTemplate/Instance, XMLTemplate/_SchemaName and an Opaque/Original byte stream. Schema and mapping are written from scratch (report/title/own95); no vendor, public or user document content, fonts, scripts, previews or body data. It is a minimal extraction fixture, not a claim that Hancom lays out a complete document from it.

Schema/Instance use the independently observed exact raw-DEFLATE + CRC32 + ISIZE stream representation with u32LE byte length + strict UTF16LE. _SchemaName is uncompressed length+UTF16LE. The source schema/mapping carry UTF16 declarations and the exact strings remain unchanged. own-decoded.json is the Native read-only oracle; production verification must call the actual selected WASM API and compare the whole DTO, not return this file as a service response.

No write/field capability follows from schema addresses. Regeneration and source ownership are documented in the selected candidate evidence.
